data.name: Settings_Appearance_V2_BlurHint
data.value: A light backdrop blur — the glass stays readable, like the iOS material.

data.name: Settings_Appearance_V2_RefractionHint
data.value: The rim lens: a quarter-circle bend that peaks at the outline and magnifies the backdrop, gone across the interior.

data.name: Settings_Appearance_V2_DispersionHint
data.value: A seven-tap spectral split along the rim displacement, strongest on the light-facing diagonal.

data.name: Settings_Appearance_V2_HighlightHint
data.value: The hairline rim stroke: additive white lit from the top-left and bottom-right diagonals, like the iOS double rim.

data.name: Settings_Appearance_V2_VibrancyHint
data.value: The iOS vibrancy colour boost; 33 ≈ the reference saturation ×1.5.

data.name: Settings_Appearance_SoftGlow_Description
data.value: The same wallpaper refraction as liquid glass, with a softer recipe: wide, gentle bending instead of a lens ring, a diffused halo instead of a hard highlight line, and an optional full-spectrum dispersion. Changes apply immediately; text stays sharp.

data.name: Settings_Appearance_SoftGlow_GlowHint
data.value: 0–100% · strength of the diffused glow around the rim

data.name: Settings_Appearance_SoftGlow_SpectrumHint
data.value: 0–100% · blends the three-tap split towards a red→violet spectrum

data.name: Settings_Appearance_SoftGlow_DyeSpreadHint
data.value: 0–100% · how far the edge colour reaches into the card; 0 = a clean rim with no wash over the content

data.name: Settings_Appearance_Glass_RefractionHint
data.value: 0–100% · bends the image near the edge

data.name: Settings_Appearance_Glass_EdgeWidthHint
data.value: 4–80 · width of the curved glass edge

data.name: Settings_Appearance_Glass_BackdropClarityHint
data.value: 25–100% · resolution the wallpaper is sampled at; lower is faster, 100% is native

data.name: Settings_Appearance_Glass_DispersionHint
data.value: 0–100% · subtle color separation at refracted edges

data.name: Settings_Appearance_Glass_EdgeTintHint
data.value: 0–100% · softly stains the rim with the colors around the edge, 0 disables

data.name: Settings_Appearance_Glass_Align_Hint
data.value: Nudge the offset until the glass background matches the real wallpaper behind the widget. Every change applies immediately to all widgets.

data.name: Settings_Appearance_Glass_LiveSamplingHint
data.value: Keep sampling the desktop so a video or animated wallpaper stays live behind the glass; turn off to freeze the current frame

data.name: Settings_Appearance_Glass_LiveSamplingIntervalHint
data.value: 3–1000 ms · shorter is smoother and costs more; 100 ms (10 fps) is already smooth behind a blur

data.name: Settings_Appearance_FocusLink_ColorPolicy_Hint

data.value: Drop .lnk or .url shortcuts into the folder and they appear here.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Enable_Subtitle
data.value: Summon an app launcher over any window with a global shortcut.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Hotkey_Subtitle
data.value: Click the field, then press the combination. Win+S and other system-owned combinations can be recorded directly; whether they take effect depends on the takeover switch below. Win+Space belongs to the Windows input-language switch, so Alt+Space is the default.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_TakeOver_Subtitle
data.value: If Windows or another app already owns a shortcut (Win+S is the usual example), take it over with a low-level keyboard hook instead of reporting a conflict. While DeskCanvas runs, that shortcut no longer opens the system surface. If the foreground window is itself elevated, DeskCanvas must also run as administrator to intercept the key.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Hotkey_NeedModifier
data.value: Use at least one modifier (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win), or a function key.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Hotkey_UnknownKey
data.value: That key cannot be used in a shortcut.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Hotkey_MissingKey
data.value: The combination has no main key.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Hotkey_Reserved
data.value: Windows reserves this combination (Win+L / Ctrl+Alt+Del); it cannot be taken over.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Status_TakenOver
data.value: Active — {0} (taken over; admin needed for elevated windows)

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Status_Conflict
data.value: Inactive: another program already owns this shortcut.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Status_Invalid
data.value: Inactive: the shortcut could not be read.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Status_Unavailable
data.value: Inactive: the system hotkey window could not be created.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Folder_Subtitle
data.value: Only .lnk and .url files directly in this folder are listed (no subfolders). Add or remove shortcuts here and the grid follows.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Columns_Subtitle
data.value: How many tiles per row in the app grid.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Height_Subtitle
data.value: Maximum vertical height of the Spotlight window when expanded.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_BlockFullscreen_Subtitle
data.value: Suppress the shortcut when a game or full-screen app owns the screen.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Blacklist_Title
data.value: Do not open in these apps

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Blacklist_Subtitle
data.value: While one of these apps is in front, the shortcut does nothing. Apps running as administrator cannot be detected.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Appearance_Theme_Subtitle
data.value: Off lets this launcher use its own material, light/dark mode and opacity without touching the rest of the app.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Appearance_Surface_Subtitle
data.value: Which material the launcher card is drawn with.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Appearance_DarkMode_Subtitle
data.value: Follow global = the same mode as the widgets; Follow system = Windows' own light/dark, even when the app is pinned the other way.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Appearance_Opacity_Subtitle
data.value: Card fill opacity. Acrylic uses it to tint the native blur.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Appearance_Radius_Subtitle
data.value: 0–100 px. Independent of the widget cards unless you follow them.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Appearance_Radius_Follow_Subtitle
data.value: Use the radius configured for the desktop widget cards (外观 → 组件圆角).

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Screen_Subtitle
data.value: Refract what is actually behind the launcher instead of the wallpaper. The launcher's own windows are excluded from the capture.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Sort_Subtitle
data.value: How the app grid is ordered. Pinned apps always stay in front.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Animation_Subtitle
data.value: Play the fade and micro-scale when the launcher opens. Off shows it instantly.

data.name: Spotlight_AppCategory_EmptyHint
data.value: Right-click an app in 全部 to file it here.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Web_Enable_Title
data.value: Search the web from the results

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Web_Enable_Subtitle
data.value: Every query also gets a “search the web” row; Enter opens the browser.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Web_Engine_Subtitle
data.value: Which site the web row searches on.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Web_Custom_Subtitle
data.value: The typed query replaces {q}. Anything else in the address is kept as written.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Web_Custom_Invalid
data.value: The address must be a full URL containing {q}, otherwise the query cannot be passed on.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Web_Browser_Subtitle
data.value: Which browser opens the result. The default browser follows Windows’ default apps.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_CategoryKeys_Desc
data.value: Press F1–F8 in the launcher to lock a category; ← / → walk the same bar while you are searching (wrapping at both ends). A key follows its category when you reorder the list with ↑ / ↓ — 全部 stays first because it is “no filter”. Click a box or Record to rebind; only function keys or a modifier combination are accepted, so typing never gets swallowed.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Orbs_Desc
data.value: The four circles beside the search field are shown while Alt is held, and Alt+1–4 opens the same categories without the gesture. Point each circle at any category; choosing one another circle already opens swaps the two, so the four always stay four different places. The number in front of each row is its shortcut and never moves.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Recent_Subtitle
data.value: Show one row of recently used apps above the grid when the query is empty, using the grid's own icons and columns.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Preview_Subtitle
data.value: Show details for the selected result on the right; hides on narrow windows.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Clipboard_Subtitle
data.value: Keep copied text, links, images and files (up to 100). Stored locally only; content is never logged.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Clipboard_Retention_Subtitle
data.value: Entries older than this are removed automatically.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Clipboard_Excluded_Subtitle
data.value: Clipboard changes are not recorded while one of these apps is in front.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Clarity_Subtitle
data.value: Resolution the backdrop is sampled at. Lower is cheaper.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Blur_Subtitle
data.value: Blur strength of the sampled backdrop.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Refraction_Subtitle
data.value: Lens displacement at the card's edge.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Vibrancy_Subtitle
data.value: Saturation boost of the refracted content.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Names_Subtitle
data.value: Draw the app name under each icon. Off leaves an icon-only grid; the filtered list still shows names.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_NameLines_Subtitle
data.value: How many lines a name may take. Every tile reserves that much space, so all icons in a row stay on one baseline; longer names end with an ellipsis.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_SearchHotkey_Subtitle
data.value: Summons the launcher as a bare search field — no app grid, one row tall until results arrive. Must differ from the app-list shortcut above.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_SearchHotkey_Same
data.value: The search-bar shortcut must differ from the app-list shortcut.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Status_SearchConflict
data.value: That combination is taken (or equals the app-list shortcut), so the search bar has no gesture.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Background_Subtitle
data.value: While following, the card takes the global solid background colour that matches the launcher's own light/dark mode; off lets you set one colour per mode. Translucency stays the material's and 不透明度's job.

data.name: Spotlight_SearchMode_Hint
data.value: Type to search · Enter opens · Esc closes

data.name: Spotlight_Calc_Hint
data.value: Press Enter to copy the result

data.name: Spotlight_Search_InvalidRegex
data.value: That regular expression is not valid.

data.name: Spotlight_Search_EverythingElevated
data.value: Everything is running as administrator, so its index cannot be queried.

data.name: Spotlight_Search_EverythingUnresponsive
data.value: Everything is running but did not answer the query — searching local folders instead. If you are using Everything Lite, note that it does not support IPC; install the full version.

data.name: Spotlight_Search_LocalIndex
data.value: Local folders only — start Everything to search the whole disk.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Gap_Subtitle
data.value: Gutter between two cells as a percentage of a cell. The icon size is derived from the column count and this gap, so the grid always fills the row exactly.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_RowGap_Subtitle
data.value: Vertical gutter between two rows, as a percentage of a cell. With app names on, the label block already makes a row taller — this is the air added on top of it, so it can be tightened to 0.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Files_Subtitle
data.value: Show file results under the app matches. Everything answers when its client is running; otherwise the built-in folder index does.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Files_AutoStart_Subtitle
data.value: Everything's index is only reachable while its client runs. The launcher starts it minimised the first time a file query needs it.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Files_Status_NotRunning
data.value: Everything is installed but not running — using the built-in folder index.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Files_Status_NotInstalled
data.value: Everything is not installed — searching desktop, documents, downloads, pictures, music and videos only.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Files_Status_Elevated
data.value: Everything runs as administrator, so a normal-integrity launcher cannot query it. Restart Everything without elevation for whole-disk results.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Files_Status_Unresponsive
data.value: Everything is running, but the last query did not answer — using the built-in folder index. If you are using the Lite build, note that it does not support IPC; install the full version.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Interval_Subtitle
data.value: How often the screen behind the launcher is re-captured, in milliseconds. Shorter keeps motion alive and costs more.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Gap_Preview
data.value: Icon {0:F0} px · gap {1:F0} px · cell {2:F0} px · row {3:F0} px

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Sample_Off
data.value: Screen sampling is off — the glass refracts the wallpaper.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Sample_None
data.value: No screen frame yet — summon the launcher once to capture one.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Glass_Sample_Ok
data.value: Screen sampling active — {0} frame(s) captured, last mean {1}.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_Web_Results_Subtitle
data.value: How many real results the launcher lists under 在浏览器中搜索 while you type (the preview comes from Bing; the row above still opens your own engine). 0 leaves only the action row — the launcher then makes no network request.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_SearchPlaceholder_Hint
data.value: Customize the search placeholder text in All category. Leave blank to use the default.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_SpaceRecent_Subtitle
data.value: When entering two spaces in the search field, show items recently opened via search.

data.name: Settings_Spotlight_SpaceRecentCount_Subtitle
data.value: Rows shown in the single-space (recent searches) and double-space (recently opened) lists (3–20).
